chain.title: A Strange Ore
chain.desc: Mine the blue-pulsing vinteum ore found underground; every wand, altar, and spell in Mana and Artifice traces back to this one mineral.

chain.title: A Blue Powder
chain.desc: Smelt raw vinteum into dust and notice it clings to iron; this powder is the universal magical reagent you will be sprinkling into recipes for the rest of the mod.

chain.title: Magnetic Metal
chain.desc: Combine vinteum dust with an iron ingot; the dust fuses into the metal, and one more trip through the furnace finishes the job.

chain.title: Tracking Down Magic
chain.desc: Smelt the coated iron into a true vinteum ingot; villagers recognize this metal, and trading it is how you find your way into the arcane.

chain.title: The Codex Arcana
chain.desc: Obtain and read the Codex Arcana to begin your magical progression. Use it alongside the Occulus: the Codex explains mechanics, while the Occulus records the tasks and requirements for your current tier.

chain.title: Scribe
chain.desc: Design a simple spell recipe at the Inscription Table using a shape and a small set of components. Check the complexity before taking the recipe to the Ritual of Arcana.

chain.title: Chalk the Circle
chain.desc: Draw the exact ritual pattern shown in the Codex and prepare its ingredients. Keep an open ritual area so you can inspect missing marks and reuse the space for later ascension work.

chain.title: Manamancer
chain.desc: Practise drawing the manaweave patterns shown in the Codex with your first wand. Accurate shapes are a crafting input, so learn a simple pattern before trying a long sequence.

chain.title: Eyes on Ascension
chain.desc: Consult the Occulus for your current tier's tasks and ascension requirements. Complete the required progression in the mod itself; collecting the quest-book items does not automatically raise your magic tier.

chain.title: Your First Spell
chain.desc: Complete the Ritual of Arcana from your inscribed recipe and cast the resulting spell. Begin with something simple enough to practise repeatedly while learning its mana cost and targeting.

chain.title: Manaweaver
chain.desc: Place the Manaweaving Altar, add the required ingredients and draw the recipe's patterns above it. Confirm the craft succeeds before expanding the workshop around it.

chain.title: Elementalist
chain.desc: Perform the appropriate lore ritual to obtain an Arcane Mote. The other elemental motes are separate ritual choices, so make the one required by your next project.

chain.title: Choose Your Allegiance
chain.desc: Meet the Occulus requirements and perform the faction-joining ritual for the path you choose. Confirm after joining your chosen faction; this checkpoint accepts your choice and does not require a Council champion trophy.

chain.title: Mana, Fused
chain.desc: Follow the fragment and crystal recipes to assemble a Mana Crystal. Keep its crafting components organised because the workshop will need more than a single decorative crystal.

chain.title: Quicksilver
chain.desc: Weave a single square pattern over a copper ingot to transmute it; quicksilver is the metal of rune-working and gates the Runeforge, Runic Anvil, and Runescribing Table.

chain.title: A Reference System
chain.desc: Bind leather, paper, and string into a book that holds and hot-swaps your growing spell list; it is also a reagent for the Altar of Arcana and the Council's faction ritual.

chain.title: Student of Rote
chain.desc: Bring the required journal material to the Study Desk and practise rote work as the Codex describes. Focus on spells you cast frequently so the benefit supports your normal play.

chain.title: Kind of Like a Familiar
chain.desc: Weave this floating orb companion at Tier 3; it hovers at your shoulder and assists your casting, and crafting one is an Occulus task on the road to Tier 4.

chain.title: Transcriptionist
chain.desc: Woven at Tier 3: lay Manaweave patterns over a Basic Table with Wizard Chalk, two Bowls, Animus Dust and an Armor Stand. Once built, it scribes a rote-mastered spell onto glyphs, staves or construct arms, so allies and automatons cast your spells without you.

chain.title: A Sanctum of Your Own
chain.desc: Perform Sanctum Invocation and finish the structure shown by the Codex. Confirm after your sanctum is established; you do not need to collect its generated central block as an item.

chain.title: Claim a Wellspring
chain.desc: Locate a suitable Eldrin wellspring with the supported sight or dowsing method, then capture it using the correct affinity equipment. Confirm after the wellspring is claimed and its power can be routed to your workshop.

chain.title: The Runeforge
chain.desc: Prepare the Runeforge for rune smithing and follow its heating instructions. The forge, Runic Anvil and Runescribing Table are parts of one workshop; learn their individual roles before attempting advanced runes.

chain.title: Runesmith
chain.desc: Use a prepared rune pattern and the required heated material at the Runic Anvil. Work through a basic rune first so you understand the smithing process before spending rare metals.

chain.title: Runecarver
chain.desc: Scribe a rune pattern onto the correct blank at this table. Carry the finished pattern to the rune-working setup; drawing a pattern is preparation for forging, not the finished enchantment.

chain.title: Arcana Without the Chalk
chain.desc: Weave a spell book, chalk, animus dust, and a marking rune into this altar; it replaces the Ritual of Arcana entirely, letting you craft higher-complexity spells with no floor art.

chain.title: The Eldrin Altar
chain.desc: Set up the Eldrin Altar and route the required wellspring power to it. Check the affinity, available power and tier requirements before attempting a greater-mote recipe.

chain.title: Eldrin Imbuement
chain.desc: Create a Greater Arcane Mote at the Eldrin Altar once your progression tier allows it. This connects the captured-wellspring network to the late ritual and equipment branches.

chain.title: The Allfather
chain.desc: Reach the required tier and prepare the Ritual of Odin's Call from the Codex. Bring the greater motes, arena and equipment the encounter deserves, then defeat Odin's trial.

chain.title: The Artifice of Your Path
chain.desc: Reach Tier 5 and craft an advanced item available to your chosen faction using the Codex recipe. Confirm after the craft succeeds. The Council's Arcane Crown is one path, not a required item for members of other factions.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game. Faction choice and late artifice are manual checkpoints. The Arcane Crown recipe requires the Council faction, so it is not forced on players who chose another faction.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Tier progression, spellcraft, manaweaving, runes, faction choice, sanctum, wellsprings and faction-neutral late artifice.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
